title: Super Castlevania IV

masks.why: the title screen's logo is laid out for 256 columns on a 32-tile map that would repeat (BG1 map at $0000, 32 tiles)

issues: At the start of a stage the left side shows old tiles: the game has not drawn the level there yet.
The game draws new columns of the level only a few tiles ahead of the SNES edge: ahead of Simon the far side columns can show old tiles.
BG3 (the score and timer, and the title's text) is filled in the sides.
The title screen is shown with black sides.

No flicker: in the 5,200 frames checked the game never drew more sprites on a line than a SNES shows (2,640 lines went over the SNES's limits with sprites that draw nothing there), so it changed nothing; it changes only lines over the limits.
Fast CPU ran the 5,200 frames checked; the game's timing changes.

verified.how: Workshop --wms-test (E6), 5,200 frames of a pad script (title, stage 1-1) in lockstep with the SNES console: widescreen's centre 256 columns identical to the SNES picture every frame, STAT77 and the sound identical, switched off frame-identical; no flicker changes only lines over the SNES's limits; better sound changes only the sound.
